title: Embedded forms (inline iframe and popup on another site) can never be submitted: every write gets 403 csrf_failed
label: Confirmed
verification: Confirmed High by 3 independent verifiers (v4, v6, v8): real Chrome, host page on a second site, inline and popup
location: src/server/app.ts:68-77 (global .use(csrf) before .route('/public/forms') :111 and '/uploads' :114); src/platform/guards.ts:114; src/platform/auth/cookies.ts:73 (SameSite=Lax); src/platform/browser.ts:84-114; src/respondent/api.ts:53,81; src/respondent/upload.ts:56; public/embed.js
evidence: Reproduced 6 times (3 areas + 3 verifiers), including against a production build (astro build + preview, security and frontend-a11y areas). Control (form opened directly): events 204, responses 200, row stored. Embedded on http://127.0.0.1:<port> (a different site): no site_csrf cookie stored or visible in the frame, POST /events 403 x2, POST /responses 403 {"error":"csrf_failed","message":"This form has expired. Reload the page and try again."}, no row written; reload gives the same. Same-site embed works (frontend-a11y samesite.mjs). Scripts/logs: C:/Users/Appifylab/intelform-audit-evidence/requirements/embed-submit.mjs+.log, C:/Users/Appifylab/intelform-audit-evidence/security/embed-csrf.mjs, C:/Users/Appifylab/intelform-audit-evidence/frontend-a11y/scripts/embed.mjs + logs/embed-cross-site.txt + shots/embed-cross-site-submit.png, C:/Users/Appifylab/intelform-audit-evidence/verify/v4/ (COMMANDS.txt), v6/, v8/.
failureScenario: A creator pastes the inline or popup embed code from the Share tab into their own website. A visitor fills every answer and presses Submit. The browser never stored the SameSite=Lax CSRF cookie inside the third-party frame, so the POST carries no x-csrf-token; the server answers 403 and the visitor reads "This form has expired. Reload the page". Reloading cannot help. View/start funnel events and signature uploads fail the same way.
impact: 100% of embedded submissions are lost on every embedding site in Chrome, Firefox and Safari while the creator believes the form is live. Embedding is an advertised channel (README.md:16-17, Share tab, public/embed.js) and a legacy DoD item (legacy/docs/PLAN.md "embed works in an iframe"). Direct /f/<slug>/ links still work (workaround), so not Critical.
fix: In src/server/app.ts mount publicFormsRoutes and the anonymous POST /uploads/signature AFTER sameOrigin and BEFORE .use(csrf), the way /checkout is mounted (a fetch from inside the frame to its own origin is Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin, so sameOrigin still refuses cross-site callers). These routes carry no session, so double-submit CSRF protects nothing; abuse is already covered by the signed render token, honeypot, Turnstile and rate limits. Make src/respondent/api.ts and upload.ts call fetch directly (credentials:'omit') instead of siteFetch so they never request /auth/csrf. Correct the comment at app.ts:105-110. Do not edit src/platform.
regressionTest: Playwright E2E against astro build + preview: host page on 127.0.0.1 embeds /f/<slug>/?embed=1 (and the embed.js popup), fill + submit, expect the end screen and a new responses row; repeat with a signature field. Integration test: POST /site-api/public/forms/:slug/responses with Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin and no CSRF cookie is not refused with csrf_failed; a signed-in route without the cookie still is.

title: A refused or failed job send after submit drops the response's owner notification, confirmation and webhook for good, while the respondent is told it was saved
label: Confirmed
verification: Confirmed High (v2: unit proof of queueResponseJobs for E_JOBS_RATE_LIMITED / E_JOBS_UNREACHABLE / E_JOBS_PAUSED; live platform 429 not reproducible locally)
location: src/server/intelform/notify/notify.ts:80-93 (queueResponseJobs catches, console.warn, returns false); src/server/intelform/respondent/submit.ts:276-284 (called after commit, result ignored); no outbox table; src/server/background.ts hourlyMaintenance has no catch-up
evidence: Hosted-mode proof through the real Site API app on audit_ops with a fake platform enforcing the documented 10 jobs/min (docs/agent/background-jobs.md:143): 15 submits from 15 IPs all got 200 and 15 rows saved, only 10 notify jobs accepted; the other 5 left only "[intelform] notify job not sent for a response (E_JOBS_RATE_LIMITED)" (C:/Users/Appifylab/intelform-audit-evidence/ops/job-loss.proof.test.ts, job-loss.result.json). Verifier v2: C:/Users/Appifylab/intelform-audit-evidence/verify/v2/queue-response-jobs-drop.test.ts, 3/3 pass (send called once, no throw, returns false). The same 10/min budget is shared with export parts, file cleanup, webhook test/resend and retention continuations.
failureScenario: A form with notifications or a webhook gets its 11th response within a minute (newsletter burst, or an admin running an export/delete at the same time). sendJob gets 429. The respondent sees "Thanks! Your response has been recorded"; the owner gets no email, the respondent no confirmation, the CRM webhook never fires, and nothing ever retries. Same on E_JOBS_UNREACHABLE (8 s timeout) or a Worker dying between commit and send.
impact: Silent loss of messages/jobs on the busiest forms; webhook receivers lose records with no trace in the delivery log. Breaks docs/agent/background-jobs.md:54 and the legacy promise "nothing is lost on restart" (legacy/README.md:133). Response data itself is kept, so not Critical.
fix: Add an intelform_outbox(response_id, created_at) row written in the same submit CTE as the INSERT (additive migration). After commit send notify-<id> and delete the row when accepted; hourly maintenance re-sends rows older than ~2 min with the same key (idempotent). Optionally batch with sendJobs and ask the owner to raise the per-minute limit.
regressionTest: Integration (hosted mode, fake platform answering 429 to /jobs): submit 1 response, assert an outbox row; run hourlyMaintenance with the platform answering 201, assert job notify-<id> sent and outbox row gone.

title: Respondent confirmations and teammate notifications are silently never sent without an owner mail-provider secret, while the dashboard says email is on and needs no setup; the owner email has no answers although the switch says it does
label: Confirmed
verification: Confirmed High by 2 verifiers (v5: real runResponseNotify on audit_v5; v1: proof test with Site Key set and no provider)
location: src/server/intelform/notify/notify.ts:288-298 (teammates only when deps.mail), :348 (if (!mail) return 'no-provider'), :102-104 (relay payload {kind,path} only); src/server/background.ts:43 (outcome discarded); src/server/routes/builder.ts:129 and src/server/intelform/settings/settings.ts:105 (emailEnabled = siteKey || localDev); mailProviderConfigured() has no caller (notify/index.ts:5-9); src/portal/intelform/settings/delivery.tsx:88,94; src/portal/intelform/builder/settings/sections.tsx:385-425 (incl. :398/:403 "Includes every answer")
evidence: Live (requirements flows4.mjs, flows4.log, flows4-serverlog.txt; privacy-legal README P3): GET /builder/capabilities {"emailEnabled":true}; form with notifyOnResponse, two ticked teammates and confirmationEmail; submit 200; server log has only "notification -> (the site owner)" with a link and no answers; no confirmation, no teammate email, no warning. v5: C:/Users/Appifylab/intelform-audit-evidence/verify/v5/notify.proof.test.ts asserted mailProviderConfigured()=false, confirmation='no-provider', notified='owner', teamEmails=0, 1 relay call, 0 console.warn, job succeeds. v1: C:/Users/Appifylab/intelform-audit-evidence/verify/v1/confirm-no-provider.test.ts (run-output.txt) same with emailEnabled()===true.
failureScenario: Default hosted site (Site Key, no Resend/Postmark key). The creator turns on "Send a confirmation to the respondent" and ticks two teammates; Settings > Delivery says there is "no mail server to set up" and "Emails are on". Every respondent gets nothing, teammates get nothing, the owner gets a link-only email (switch promised every answer). No screen, job result or log says so.
impact: Silent loss of every confirmation and teammate notification on default installs; the in-app copy contradicts README.md:95-99. No data lost, the owner still gets a link, so High not Critical.
fix: Return mailConfigured: mailProviderConfigured() (separately from relay availability) from GET /builder/capabilities and app-settings; disable or warn on the confirmation switch and the teammate list when false. Rewrite delivery.tsx:88/94 and sections.tsx:398/403/406 to say what is really sent (owner: link via platform; confirmations/teammates: need a provider). Record the 'no-provider' outcome in the job result (Jobs tab) and print skipped confirmations in local dev as README promises. Remove description={m.email} drift separately (F-030).
regressionTest: Route test: no provider secret => capabilities.mailConfigured=false. Portal test: the confirmation switch shows the warning when false. Notify job test: confirmation 'no-provider' is surfaced in the job result, not swallowed. Unit test of relay payload shape vs switch copy.

title: Owner notifications sent through the platform relay are dropped silently when the relay answers 429 (5 per recipient per hour); job counts as success and never retries
label: Confirmed
verification: Confirmed High for the app-side drop (v3: real relayToOwner/runResponseNotify with fetch stubbed to 429). Platform applying the 5/recipient/h cap to kind 'notification' is Likely (documented, not observable locally). Sub-claim that respondents can exhaust the site quota for sign-in codes is Unconfirmed (depends on whether refused sends count).
location: src/server/intelform/notify/notify.ts:102-120 (relayToOwner: 401/422/429 -> 'refused', no throw), :287-296, :333 (still reports 'owner'); src/server/background.ts:42-44; limits STORE-LISTING.md:34-36, docs/agent/auth.md:133-136
evidence: ops job-loss.proof.test.ts case relay429: runResponseNotify resolved {notified:'owner'}, 1 relay call, 0 done markers, no throw. v3: C:/Users/Appifylab/intelform-audit-evidence/verify/v3/relay-429.proof.test.ts (run log relay-429.run.log), 3/3 pass; only trace is console.warn "owner notification: the platform answered 429". Re-run: npx vitest run --config C:/Users/Appifylab/intelform-audit-evidence/verify/v3/relay-429.vitest.config.ts
failureScenario: Notifications on, no provider (every notification, including ones meant for ticked teammates, goes to the one owner address). From about the 6th response in an hour the relay answers 429; the owner never hears about those responses, and the dashboard shows nothing.
impact: Silent loss of owner notifications under normal traffic (10 submits/min/IP/form is allowed). Possible (Unconfirmed) knock-on: site-wide relay quota shared with sign-in codes and password resets.
fix: Digest instead of one relay email per response: at most one "N new responses on <form>" per form per 15-30 min (hitWindow). Treat 429 as retryable with delay or record a pending digest; never report 'owner' when refused. Keep owner relay traffic below a fixed share of the 120/h site quota.
regressionTest: Unit: relay fake answers 429 => runResponseNotify throws (retry) or records a pending digest, never resolves notified:'owner'. 50 responses in 10 min => 1 relay email.

title: Valid submissions over 64 KB are refused with 413 although submit promises 256 KB of answers (non-Latin long answers cannot be sent)
label: Confirmed
verification: Not independently verified (Medium); reproduced live by 3 areas
location: src/server/app.ts:27-33,74-77 (global bodyLimit 64 KB; only PATCH /forms/:id gets 512 KB) vs src/server/intelform/respondent/submit.ts:23,44,81-86 (MAX_ANSWERS_BYTES 256 KB unreachable); src/respondent/api.ts:47-58 (generic message)
evidence: requirements flows3.mjs/flows3.log: 3 x 8,000 CJK chars (72,037 B, each within the 10,000-char limit) => 413 {"error":"too_large"}; 63 KB => 200. api respondent.mjs section 1 (respondent.out): 3 x 10k CJK (90,037 B) => 413 in 54 ms. ops big-submit.log: 70 KB => 413.
failureScenario: A respondent writing Chinese, Japanese, Bengali or Arabic fills three long-text questions within each field's limit; Submit shows "That request is too large." with no field named; retries fail the same way.
impact: Responses that pass validation cannot be saved for a real group of respondents; creator never learns. Workaround: shorten answers.
fix: Give POST /site-api/public/forms/:slug/responses its own bodyLimit (~320 KB) in app.ts like the autosave route; keep assertAnswerSize as the real check; map 413 in the respondent UI to "Shorten the longest answers".
regressionTest: Integration: 3 long_text answers of 10,000 "漢" (~90 KB) => 200 and one row; ~300 KB of answers => 413 payload_too_large.

title: Anyone can lock every respondent out of a password-protected form for the rest of each hour (form-wide failure cap refuses the correct password); route calls verifyPassword itself
label: Confirmed
verification: Not independently verified (Medium); reproduced live by 2 areas
location: POST /site-api/public/forms/:slug/unlock: src/server/routes/public-forms.ts:31-35 (UNLOCK_FORM_FAILURE_LIMIT=100), :94-100 (form-wide rateLimit checked before verifyPassword at :96-97); rule docs/agent/security.md:169-170
evidence: api misc.mjs unlock (misc.out) and security unlock-lockout.mjs (unlock-lockout.out.txt): 11 addresses x 10 wrong passwords => 100 x 422 then 10 x 429; a fresh address with the CORRECT password => 429 "This form has had too many wrong passwords. Try again later." until the end of the fixed hourly window (37 s of attacker time).
failureScenario: Someone runs a loop each hour sending ~100 wrong passwords from 10+ IPs; every real respondent typing the right password is refused for the rest of that hour, indefinitely.
impact: Cheap, repeatable denial of service on any password-protected form; lost responses look like an outage to the creator.
fix: Check the per-IP limit, then verify, and count only failures; never let the form-wide budget refuse a correct password (use backoff/Turnstile on the form-wide budget, or exempt callers with no own failures). Require a valid render token before unlock. Route through a template-managed limiter or document the exception per security.md.
regressionTest: Integration: 100 wrong unlocks from 10 keyed IPs, then the correct password from a new IP => 200 with token; wrong password from an 11th IP inside the minute => 422/429.

title: A retried submit stores duplicate responses (no idempotency key): duplicate rows, emails, webhooks and cap slots
label: Confirmed
location: src/lib/intelform/api-public.ts:90-105 (no submission id); src/server/intelform/respondent/submit.ts:180-291; rule AGENTS.md Production rules ("guard anything a person may repeat with a unique key")
evidence: api respondent.mjs section 2 (respondent.out): identical body (same render token, browserToken, answers) POSTed 3x in parallel => 200,200,200; GET responses lists 3 rows; each insert queues its own notify job.
failureScenario: On a weak mobile link the server commits but the reply is lost; the form re-enables Submit; the respondent presses again => second row, second owner email, second confirmation, second webhook; with a cap, a slot is wasted.
impact: Duplicate data in table, summary and exports; duplicate downstream CRM records; relay quota spent.
fix: Respondent generates a submissionId (uuid) once per fill; add column + partial UNIQUE (form_id, submission_id) (additive migration); INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING in the CTE; on conflict answer {ok:true} without re-queueing jobs.
regressionTest: Integration: two identical submits with the same submissionId (sequential and parallel) => 200 both, one row, one notify job.

title: Concurrent publishes create duplicate versions and then reject respondents who are part-way through the form (409 version_unknown)
label: Confirmed
location: src/server/intelform/builder/publish.ts:33-52 (LEFT JOIN form_versions ... FOR UPDATE OF f; early return re-evaluated under READ COMMITTED); src/portal/.../PublishButton.tsx:63-78 (no Idempotency-Key); effect src/server/intelform/respondent/submit.ts:102-118
evidence: race-publish.mjs (race-publish.log): one unpublished change, 20 concurrent POST /forms/:id/publish => 20 x 200, versions 1 -> 21. race-publish-impact.mjs: 1 publish => a v1 respondent submits 200; 2 concurrent publishes => same respondent 409 version_unknown; 5 publishes with one Idempotency-Key => one v2, respondent 200.
failureScenario: Two teammates (or two tabs, or a network retry) press Publish on the same edit within a few hundred ms; v2 and v3 are identical; everyone who opened v1 and submits inside the promised 24 h grace gets "This form has changed. Reload the page".
impact: Mid-form respondents lose submissions; version history fills with duplicates that are never deleted.
fix: Lock the form row first (SELECT ... FROM forms WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE), then read form_versions in a second statement, or decide on has_unpublished alone; have PublishButton send an Idempotency-Key per click.
regressionTest: Integration: has_unpublished=true, 10 concurrent publishes => exactly one new version and all replies name it; a submit with the previous version => 200.

title: Migration 20261116150000_review_fixes is not wrapped in a transaction: a mid-file failure leaves the live DB half-migrated and blocks every later deploy
label: Confirmed
verification: Not independently verified (Medium); reproduced by 2 areas on throwaway DBs
location: prisma/migrations/20261116150000_review_fixes/migration.sql:1-226 (no BEGIN;/COMMIT;); rule docs/agent/database.md:257; rollback model docs/agent/publishing.md:10-12
evidence: data-concurrency migration-partial-apply.log and ops migration-partial.log: forced failure near the end => P3018; forms.starts_total, contacts, form_response_hours, triggers and functions remain; next deploy fails (P3009 / "column starts_total already exists") until manual repair. Every other app migration is wrapped.
failureScenario: On a site with a large responses table, the contacts/hours backfill or CREATE TRIGGER ON responses hits a lock/statement timeout; the publish fails "keeping the previous version", but the new triggers already fire on that version's inserts, and every later publish fails.
impact: Blocked deploys and a live DB that needs manual repair a site owner cannot easily do.
fix: Wrap the file in BEGIN; ... COMMIT; (no CONCURRENTLY statements inside). If this migration has already been applied anywhere, do not edit it (checksum) - instead make it idempotent in a new migration; confirm with the template owner before changing an applied file.
regressionTest: Store/unit check: every app migration.sql (except single CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY files) starts with BEGIN; and ends with COMMIT;. Test that applies review_fixes with a forced failure and asserts no new objects remain.

title: Contact erase, response delete and retention leave the erased answers in ready exports that stay downloadable for up to 24 h
label: Confirmed
verification: Not independently verified (Medium); reproduced by 2 areas
location: src/server/intelform/contacts/query.ts:229-266 (deleteContacts); src/server/intelform/responses/table.ts:227-250; src/server/background.ts:122-166 (applyRetention); intelform_export_parts swept 24 h after created_at (exports/job.ts sweepExports); promise src/portal/screens/contacts.tsx:148
evidence: data-concurrency erase-coverage.mjs (erase-coverage.log): contacts export ready, then erase => {contacts:1,responses:2}, responses/contacts/deliveries 0 rows, but an export_parts row still holds the email and GET /exports/:id/download => 200 with the erased email. privacy-legal README P4: same for kind responses and the all-responses ZIP; retention-probe.test.ts on real Postgres deleted 46 -> 41 responses and both export parts stayed.
failureScenario: Staff export all responses; a respondent then asks to be erased; the admin erases and is told it is permanent; the earlier export with their name, email and answers is still downloadable for ~24 h. Same after retention.
impact: Erasure and retention promises broken for up to 24 h; limited to the exporting user.
fix: In deleteContacts, deleteResponses, applyRetention and form delete, delete (or mark stale and refuse download of) every intelform_exports row created before the delete that may contain the affected rows (simplest: all ready/running exports of kind all/contacts and responses of affected forms). Say in the erase dialog that existing exports are removed and that webhook/email copies are outside the app.
regressionTest: Integration: ready contacts export, erase a contact in it => GET /exports/:id/download returns 404/410 or no longer contains the email; same after applyRetention.

title: No audit event, re-verification or typed confirmation for IntelForm's destructive and bulk-export actions
label: Confirmed
verification: Not independently verified (Medium); reproduced by 3 areas
location: src/server/routes/forms.ts:338 (DELETE form), responses.ts:189-190,227, contacts.ts:79 (erase), exports.ts:63 (kind all), builder.ts:201 (secret rotation), app-settings.ts:42; rules docs/agent/security.md:171-173,198-199,290; docs/agent/database.md:248-250
evidence: api (matrix/lifecycle/delete/misc.mjs), security no-audit.mjs (no-audit.out.txt), privacy-legal: after deleting forms and responses, erasing a contact (no confirmation), exporting all, rotating a webhook secret and changing settings, audit_events held only signed_in_with_password, user_registered and user_roles_changed. grep "audit(\|requireVerified" src/server finds no IntelForm file.
failureScenario: An editor (or stolen editor session) erases contacts and bulk-deletes responses, or an admin downloads a ZIP of every response; the owner opens /dashboard/activity and sees nothing.
impact: No accountability or forensic trail for permanent deletion and bulk PII export; breach of the project's own security rules.
fix: Call the template audit helper with form_deleted, responses_deleted(count), contacts_erased(count), export_started(kind, formId), webhook_secret_rotated, app_settings_changed(keys) - ids and counts only, no PII. Add requireVerified and a typed confirmation to POST /contacts/delete and exports of kind all.
regressionTest: Integration: each of the 6 routes writes exactly one audit_events row with the expected action, the actor id and no email in meta; /contacts/delete and kind:all without confirm => 422.

title: A webhook retry whose job send is refused is marked done and never retried; builder copy says "One attempt per response" while deliveries retry up to 4 times
label: Confirmed
location: src/server/intelform/notify/notify.ts:410-422 (send refused -> markDone + 'failed'); src/portal/intelform/builder/settings/WebhookSection.tsx:109; background.json:7-8 (retries 4); README.md:26,66; legacy/docs/PLAN.md:30 ("no automatic retries")
evidence: ops job-loss.proof.test.ts third case: first attempt 503, retry send throws JobRejected(E_JOBS_RATE_LIMITED) => webhook:'failed'; re-running the job skips the webhook (done marker). Live on audit_ops against a 500 receiver: 2 attempts with one webhook-id (webhook-target-requests.log), log says "it would try 4 more times", contradicting the UI copy (requirements finding, code read).
failureScenario: A receiver blips 5xx during the same busy minute the site is at its 10 jobs/min limit; the delivery stays failed forever unless someone presses Resend. A non-idempotent receiver told "one attempt" double-processes retries.
impact: Webhook deliveries lost under load; creators told two different retry policies.
fix: When the retry send is refused, throw instead of marking done (other steps are guarded by their markers). Change the copy to "Retried a few times on network errors and 5xx; dedupe on webhook-id; resend from the log".
regressionTest: Unit: webhook fetch 503 + send throwing JobRejected => runResponseNotify throws and the next run attempts the webhook again. Copy test on WebhookSection.

title: One-per-email race returns 500 "Something went wrong" instead of 422 "already responded"; the existing race test asserts nothing
label: Confirmed
location: src/server/intelform/respondent/submit.ts:146-153 (isEmailKeyViolation requires P2002/23505 code; Prisma raw query raises P2010 with SQLSTATE only in the message), catch at ~:276; tests/integration/respondent.test.ts:102-110 (filters 422s then .every() on an empty array)
evidence: flows2/flows3.mjs (flows3.log), 3 rounds of 3 parallel submits with one email: each round one 200 and the others 500 {"error":"internal_error"}; server log: Raw query failed. Code: 23505 ... responses_email_key.
failureScenario: A respondent double-submits (two tabs, retry) to a one-per-email form; the second request shows "Something went wrong." instead of "You have already responded".
impact: No duplicate stored (unique index holds) but a misleading error and 500s in the logs; documented 422 behaviour broken under race.
fix: In isEmailKeyViolation also accept P2010 (and driver-adapter errors) whose message/meta contains 23505 and responses_email_key; check against the platform db-socket error shape.
regressionTest: Change the integration race test to expect sorted statuses exactly [200, 422, 422].

title: Built-in consent fields make respondents agree to a privacy policy that is empty and unlinked; no privacy notice where data is collected
label: Confirmed
location: src/lib/intelform/form/templates/index.ts:31-38 (consent() helper, link null; used :66, :250); src/lib/intelform/form/types/advanced.ts:99-103; intelform_settings.privacy_text default ''; src/pages/f/[slug].astro (no privacy link); settings/site.tsx:112-113
evidence: privacy-legal README P1: form from builtin-lead-capture published; GET /site-api/public/forms/<slug> has required consent {"text":"I agree to the privacy policy ...","link":null}; GET /public-site/legal/privacy => text ""; /f/ HTML has no link to /privacy/.
failureScenario: An owner makes a lead form from the built-in template; each respondent must tick "I agree to the privacy policy" to submit, but no policy exists or is linked, and nothing tells them answers go to a mail provider or webhook receivers.
impact: Consent is not informed and there is no notice at collection (GDPR Art. 13) out of the box on every new install using these templates. Workaround: write a policy and link it per field.
fix: Default the template consent link to /privacy/ (or render a "How your answers are used" link on /f/* when privacy text exists); warn in the builder (or block publish) for a consent field while privacy text is empty; ship a starting privacy text listing stored data and processors.
regressionTest: Unit: every built-in template consent field has a link (or the renderer adds one). Integration: publishing a consent form with empty privacy text returns a warning.

title: A keyed IP hash is stored on every response, never read, and joins to staff accounts' login hashes, contradicting the Survey template's "Your answers are anonymous"
label: Confirmed
location: src/server/intelform/respondent/submit.ts:264-266; src/server/intelform/respondent/crypto.ts:87-89 (subjectHash(secret,'ip',ip), same as audit_events/refresh_tokens/login_attempts.ip_hash); src/lib/intelform/form/templates/index.ts:135; src/content/site.ts:149; rules database.md:251, security.md:289
evidence: privacy-legal README P2: survey from builtin-survey ("Your answers are anonymous") submitted with cf-connecting-ip 203.0.113.7, admin signed in from the same IP; SQL join responses.ip_hash = refresh_tokens.ip_hash returns user_id 1 (one match each in refresh_tokens, audit_events, login_attempts). grep: ip_hash written at submit.ts:264, read nowhere.
failureScenario: A staff member answers the built-in "anonymous" survey from their usual network; anyone with DB access joins responses.ip_hash to refresh_tokens and names them; the same hash links one person across all forms.
impact: A respondent-facing privacy promise is false; purposeless pseudonymous data kept against the project rule "store the minimum".
fix: Stop writing responses.ip_hash (rate limits have their own keys); if ever needed use a per-form rotating salt. Store browser_token only when onePerBrowser is on. Remove "Your answers are anonymous" or add a real anonymous mode that skips country/device/browser.
regressionTest: Integration: after a submit, responses.ip_hash IS NULL and no responses column equals refresh_tokens.ip_hash for the same client IP.

title: No way to export one person's data (access request); the contacts CSV holds no answers
label: Confirmed
location: src/server/routes/exports.ts:63-124; src/server/intelform/contacts/query.ts:270 (CSV_HEADERS); rule docs/agent/database.md:248-250, security.md:290
evidence: privacy-legal: POST /site-api/exports {kind:'contacts', query:{key:<contact with 4 responses>}} => CSV with only Name,Email,Phone,Country,Responses,Forms,First seen,Last active; contact detail API lists responses without answers.
failureScenario: A respondent sends an access request; staff must open every form and every response one by one, because the per-contact export has no answers.
impact: Access requests are not practically supported; breaches the project's per-person export rule. (Audit part merged into F-011.)

title: Respondent page /f/<slug>/ misses the spec LCP (2.9 s vs 1.5 s on mobile Slow 4G) and its static JS (~125 KB gz) is over the 110 KB budget; no budget gate exists
label: Confirmed
location: src/pages/f/[slug].astro:104 (PublicForm client:only="react", SSR body has no visible content); budget legacy/docs/research/03-respondent.md + legacy/e2e/helpers/bundle-size.ts (not ported)
evidence: Production build via astro preview behind gzip proxy; Lighthouse 12.8.2 mobile, 3 identical runs on /f/contact-us/: perf 94, FCP 1.7 s, LCP 2.9 s (render delay 2,462 ms = 84%). page-weight.mjs: 113.7 KB static JS + layout chunks ~125 KB gz. C:/Users/Appifylab/intelform-audit-evidence/performance/lighthouse/summary.txt, logs/page-weight-unauth.log.
failureScenario: A respondent on a mid-range phone (or inside an embed) sees only the themed background for ~3 s before the first question appears; future bundle growth goes unnoticed.

regressionTest: Post-build test: /f/<seed>/ HTML contains the title and first question outside <noscript>, and the static JS closure is <= 110 KB gz; manual Lighthouse LCP <= 1.5 s as release check.

title: Keyboard users cannot add a question from the builder palette: Enter/Space on "Add <type>" starts a hidden drag instead of adding

impact: WCAG 2.1.1 failure on the most visible build path; workaround exists.

title: The required template upgrade will turn the test suite red: the app changed 5 template-owned test files that upgrade.md overwrites, and nothing records the edits
label: Confirmed
location: tests/integration/support/harness.ts:158-163; tests/integration/admin.test.ts:89-114; tests/list-page.test.ts:16-23; tests/permissions.test.ts:22-100; docs/agent/upgrade.md step 3

title: The documented release gate does not run the integration suite: npm run check passes with 20 of 84 files / 175 tests skipped, and there is no CI

evidence: baseline #10: npm run check without TEST_DATABASE_URL => 64 passed / 20 skipped files, 1453 passed / 175 skipped tests (every auth, permission, submit, delete, erase, export test) (C:/Users/Appifylab/intelform-audit-evidence/baseline/logs/19-npm-run-check.clean.log).
failureScenario: A developer runs the gate on a fresh clone, sees green, and submits code that breaks submit, delete or erase.
impact: Core-flow regressions can ship through a green gate.
fix: Make npm run check fail (or loudly warn) when TEST_DATABASE_URL is unset, or start a throwaway Postgres for it; document in DEVELOPERS.md.
regressionTest: Running npm run check without TEST_DATABASE_URL exits non-zero or prints the skipped count prominently.

title: No typecheck in any gate; astro check is red (4 TS2345 errors incl. src/pages/f/[slug].astro:62) and plain tsc is red on a fresh clone until astro sync

title: An export whose job runs out of retries stays "running" for 24 h with no failed state
label: Likely

evidence: Code trace: non-ExportError throws and refused next-part sends rely on platform retries; after the last try nothing sets status=failed; status route has no staleness check; only the 24 h sweep removes it. Map lead E1 also notes a possible same-key re-send dedupe (Suspected).
failureScenario: An "export all" on a large site keeps hitting the run limit; the dashboard shows "running" for up to 24 h.
impact: Hung export with no signal; workaround: start a new export.
fix: Mark an export failed when running with updated_at older than ~15 min (status route or hourly job); show "didn't finish, try again".
regressionTest: Integration: insert a running export with updated_at 20 min ago => GET /exports/:id returns failed.

title: Two parallel webhook delivery stacks have drifted ("Send test"/"Resend" vs real deliveries); a header value with a newline is saved (200) and then silently dropped by both
label: Confirmed
verification: V↓ from Medium: Confirmed Low (v7). Headline scenario (trailing newline sent by Test but not by real delivery) REFUTED - both drop it. Reproduced: NUL kept by Test path (fetch throws) but dropped by real path; legacy map-form headers sent only by real path; save schema accepts CR/LF/NUL
location: src/server/intelform/builder/webhook-core.ts:96-116 vs src/server/intelform/webhooks/config.ts:17-36; src/lib/intelform/form/settings.ts:45-53; dead queueWebhookDelivery/resendDelivery/assertWebhookUrl; stale comment webhook-delivery.ts:21-27
evidence: C:/Users/Appifylab/intelform-audit-evidence/code-quality/differential.test.ts (differential.log): the two readWebhookConfig copies differ in 4/5 cases. v7: C:/Users/Appifylab/intelform-audit-evidence/verify/v7/webhook-header-drift.ts (.out.txt), run with npx tsx.
failureScenario: A creator pastes an Authorization value ending in a newline; save says OK; both test and real deliveries go out without the header and the receiver answers 401 with no hint why.
impact: Maintainability drift (a fix in one stack misses the other) plus a silently-dropped header.
fix: Keep one readWebhookConfig/secret/signed-POST implementation; delete dead functions and fix the comment; add .refine(v => !/[\r\n\0]/.test(v)) to webhookHeader.value (422 "Use one line").
regressionTest: Unit: same settings through Test and real path produce identical headers; PUT webhook with a newline in a header value => 422.

title: Malformed or empty JSON bodies return 500 internal_error on ~19 signed-in routes; a text/plain body is treated as {} and still creates a form
label: Confirmed
location: src/server/app.ts:115-124 (onError turns hono HTTPException 400 into 500); routes using validator('json')/zodJson (E16, E48, E56, E57, E62, E63, E65, E68, E78, E82, E85, E87, E98, E99, E102, E104, E107)
evidence: api matrix.out lines 471-519 + server-500-causes.log ("Malformed JSON in request body"); text/plain POST /forms => 201 blank form. code-quality bad-input-sweep.log, malformed-json.log.
failureScenario: A truncated autosave sends broken JSON; the API answers 500 and logs an error-level server fault.
impact: Noisy monitoring, misreported client errors; an unintended side effect for wrong content types.
fix: In app.onError return err.getResponse() (or a 400 invalid_json problem) for HTTPException; refuse non-JSON content types on JSON writes with 415.
regressionTest: POST /site-api/forms with "{" => 400; empty => 400; text/plain => 415 and no form inserted.

title: A NUL character or lone surrogate gives 500: an anonymous submit fails every time and dashboard search breaks
label: Confirmed

failureScenario: A respondent pastes text with a NUL or broken emoji; Submit fails with the generic error forever.
impact: Rare, but a lost submission with no hint.
fix: Strip/reject \u0000 and unpaired surrogates (toWellFormed) in the shared text answer schema and in every q schema; 422 field error for answers.
regressionTest: Submit with \u0000 and \ud800 => 200 (sanitised) or 422, never 500; GET /forms?q=%00 => 200.

title: Retention: README says per-form retention but it is one app-wide setting; the retention job does not clear the summary and contacts caches

title: Local dev server silently ignores DATABASE_URL from the shell and uses .env, while Prisma CLI and dev-admin honour the shell
label: Confirmed

failureScenario: A developer points DATABASE_URL at a throwaway DB to test retention or erase; migrations go there, the running app deletes from the .env database.

fix: Document it; have the dev server log the database name (not URL) at startup and warn when process.env.DATABASE_URL differs from .env; dev-admin/seed print their target. App-level tooling only.
regressionTest: Smoke script: start dev with a different shell DATABASE_URL and assert the warning.

title: Contacts rollup loses updates when a submit and a delete for the same person run at the same time on different forms
label: Confirmed

fix: pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(key)) per key (sorted) in both triggers, or lock contacts rows before recomputing, or make the delete trigger decrement.
regressionTest: Two-connection integration test asserting contacts.n and form_ids equal the truth after both commit.

title: "One response per browser" does not hold under concurrent submits (25 of 40 identical-token submits stored)

failureScenario: A double-click or scripted retry stores several responses on a one-per-browser form, each firing notifications and webhooks.
impact: Duplicates on a setting labelled a "soft limit".
fix: Partial UNIQUE index on responses(form_id, browser_token) WHERE browser_token IS NOT NULL (additive), map 23505 to 409.
regressionTest: 10 parallel submits, same browserToken => 1 row, 9 x 409.

title: /site-api/health reports ok and database:true while the database is down

failureScenario: An uptime probe says healthy during a full DB outage.
impact: Outage undetectable from the only health endpoint.
fix: Cached, rate-limited SELECT 1 with short timeout; database:'up'|'down' and 503 when down.
regressionTest: DATABASE_URL to a closed port => /health 503 database:'down'.

title: Respondent API answers 500 internal_error, not 503 with Retry-After, when the database is unreachable

location: src/server/app.ts:120-124 (onError -> 500), affects E91, E94, E111

failureScenario: During a DB blip respondents get a generic error that does not say "try again in a moment".
impact: Poor recovery guidance; monitoring cannot tell outage from bug.
fix: Map P1001/P1017, SQLSTATE 55000/57P01 to 503 + Retry-After in onError; respondent UI "try again in a moment".
regressionTest: Unreachable DB => POST responses 503 + Retry-After.

title: Webhook delivery log polls every 3 s forever while any delivery stays "pending"; nothing expires a stuck pending row
label: Confirmed
location: src/portal/intelform/builder/settings/queries.ts:55; src/server/intelform/builder/webhook-core.ts:185; no sweep in src/server/background.ts

failureScenario: A lost test-delivery job leaves "sending" forever and every open Webhook tab polls every 3 s.
impact: ~80 billed queries/min per open tab; misreported lost delivery.
fix: Treat rows with no outcome older than ~10 min as failed ("Delivery didn't run. Use Resend."), or mark them in hourly maintenance; cap the client poll.
regressionTest: Delivery row 1 h old with no outcome => pending:false, ok:false.

title: Home page downloads 3 font families (83 KB, more than its JS+CSS) and /fonts/* are served max-age=0
